title: The Mirror Jelly's Reflected Sparks
story: In a moonlit tidepool cave, Vollowmere the Mirror Jelly has sealed the old lamplighter inside a glassy bubble of brine. Its mirror skin reflects 40% of every spark blast straight back into the water, and the bubble's shell takes 180 sparks of real damage to crack open. Mr 6's spark-wand fires blasts of 50 sparks each.
question: How many spark blasts must Mr 6 fire to crack the 180-spark shell, if 40% of each 50-spark blast is reflected away?
solution: Each blast loses 40% of 50 = 20 sparks to the mirror skin.
So only 50 - 20 = 30 sparks actually land per blast.
praise: Dividing 180 by the blast size was smart thinking — the step that was missing is shrinking each blast by the 40% the mirror skin bounces away.
hint: First work out 40% of 50 sparks — that's the part that never reaches the shell.
victory: On the sixth blast the brine bubble pops like a soap bubble, and the lamplighter sloshes free, dripping and delighted. Vollowmere jiggles away, deeply annoyed that someone did the percent first.
imagePrompt: A numeral-six knight aiming a glowing spark-wand at a huge translucent mirrored jellyfish holding a trapped lamplighter in a bubble, inside a moonlit sea cave shimmering with reflected light.
